claim: The AP said all corporate-owned stores had shuttered by 2014, the Anchorage and Fairbanks stores shut in 2018 (just after a Redmond, Oregon store), leaving Bend the only U.S. location, and the Perth, Australia store shut in 2019, leaving Bend the last in the world.

source.title: Associated Press, "The last Blockbuster in Bend more popular after Netflix documentary"

quote: by 2014, all corporate-owned stores had shuttered. That left locally owned franchises like the one in Bend to fend for themselves, and one by one, they closed. When stores in Anchorage and Fairbanks, Alaska, shut down in 2018 — barely outlasting a Redmond, Oregon, store — Bend’s Blockbuster was the only U.S. location left. Then, in 2019, the only other Blockbuster in Perth, Australia, shut its doors, leaving Bend as the last store.
